Skills2Job Architecture & ML Pipeline

Interactive end-to-end flow from raw text extraction to explainable 5-factor career matchmaking.

Open Live Dashboard →Exit to Home

Candidate Pipeline

1. USER RESUMEpdfplumber / PyMuPDF

PDF / Word upload containing unstructured candidate credentials.

2. TEXT EXTRACTIONRegex & Text Heuristics

Normalized raw character stream sanitized from layout artifacts.

3. SPACY / NLP PARSINGspaCy NLP & Pattern Matchers

Named entity recognition (NER) mapping tokens to tech taxonomies.

4. SKILL EXTRACTIONJSON Schema Structuring

Parsed skills + experience years + project highlights mapped to JSON.

5. CANDIDATE EMBEDDINGSentence Transformers (384-dim)

Dense vector representations generated from normalized skill profile.

Job Requirement Pipeline

1. JOB DESCRIPTIONHR Input / REST API

Unstructured employer posting from HR portal or scraper.

2. JOB PARSERBeautifulSoup / Pydantic

HTML parsing and section segmentation into responsibilities & requirements.

3. REQUIREMENT EXTRACTION3-Tier Skill Separation Engine

Separates Required skills (40%), Preferred skills, and Bonus skills.

4. JOB PROFILEPostgreSQL / SQLAlchemy

Structured job entity stored in relational schema with metadata.

5. JOB EMBEDDINGSentence Transformers (384-dim)

Dense vector generated from required competencies and role context.

Vector Convergence & Match Formulation
Mathematical Convergence

Candidate Vector + Job Vector Matching Engine

pgvector & Cosine Similarity

Step 1: COSINE SIMILARITY CALCULATION

sim(A, B) = (A · B) / (||A|| ||B||)

Calculates semantic closeness between candidate vector and job vector in high-dimensional embedding space.

Step 2: STRUCTURED 5-FACTOR WEIGHTED MATCHING

Overall = (Skill × 0.40) + (Exp × 0.20) + (Edu × 0.15) + (Projects × 0.15) + (ATS × 0.10)

Blends deterministic criteria (skills, years, degree) with semantic cosine similarity.

Step 3: COMPATIBILITY & ELIGIBILITY ENGINE

Eligible if Required Skills ≥ 80% and Experience ≥ (Min - 0.5)

Distinguishes Eligibility (hard gates) from Compatibility (ranking), preventing unfair bonus-skill rejections.

Step 4: SKILL GAP ANALYSIS & LEARNING ROADMAP

Missing = Required_Skills ∖ Candidate_Skills

Ranks missing skills by employer market demand and generates a 4-week project roadmap.

Step 5: JOB RANKING & RECOMMENDATIONS

Ranked list sorted descending by Compatibility Score

Surfaces top opportunities to candidate and ranks best candidates for recruiters.

5 Core Product Axioms Communicated to Examiners:

1. Ingestion"I upload my resume."
2. Comprehension"Skills2Job understands my skills and experience."
3. Alignment"It understands what jobs require."
4. Explainability"It tells me how good my match is (and WHY)."
5. Actionability"It tells me exactly what I should improve."
